**Question:** Compare modern approaches for detecting fraud in highly imbalanced transaction datasets, including how such models should be evaluated.

## Summary

Machine learning classifiers enhance proactive fraud detection in financial systems. [S3] A combined F1 score and g-mean, in that specific order, is the best evaluation metric for typical imbalanced fraud detection models. [S3]

## Real-Time Implementation Challenges

Latency is the time it takes for the system to process a transaction and make an inference. [S5]

## Data Preprocessing Techniques

SMOTE (Synthetic Minority Over-sampling Technique) generates synthetic examples of the minority class to balance datasets. [S4]

## Scalability Challenges

Credit card fraud detection systems face challenges including massively unbalanced fraud data and difficulty creating gold standard ground truth. [S3]

## Failure Modes of Traditional Metrics

Traditional accuracy metrics can be misleading when evaluating models on imbalanced datasets. [S4]
